Numerical simulations were performed using the author’s C++ code, which is designed to simulate
arbitrary piecewise quadric billiards in arbitrary dimensions. The flight time is thus given the solution of
a quadratic equation; simplifications for the cases where the matrix defining the quadratic form is zero or

the particle remains on the correct side of the boundary, while retaining as much accuracy as possible for

very small perpendicular distance of the boundary. Tests were made comparing 16 and 19 digit precision
